content: The ACC 2010 schedule outlines the coordination of interviews and presentations during the conference, which will take place at the Atlanta Marriott Downtown, located at 160 Spring Street, Atlanta, GA 30303. Filming and interviews are scheduled from Saturday, March 13, 2010, to Tuesday, March 16, 2010. Dr. Gibson is available for interviews during the times listed in black, while the times in green indicate his unavailability for interviews. However, during these green time slots, participants may still present their topics or slides. Saturday, March 13, 2010: 9:00 AM: No interview scheduled. 9:30 AM: No interview scheduled. 10:15 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Robert M. Califf. Discussion on the NAVIGATOR trial, which investigates the effects of nateglinide and valsartan in patients with impaired glucose tolerance. 11:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Manesh R. A. Verheugt. 12:00 PM: No interview scheduled. 12:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Tracy Y. Wang. Presentation on the use of upfront clopidogrel and the efficacy and safety of early eptifibatide in acute coronary syndrome patients, based on the EARLY ACS trial. 1:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Chiara Melloni. Presentation on the safety and efficacy of adjusted-dose eptifibatide in acute coronary syndrome patients with reduced renal function. 1:30 PM: No interview scheduled. 2:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Francois Schiele. Discussion on gender differences in outcomes after acute myocardial infarction, analyzed using propensity score matching. 2:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Michael Maeng. Discussion on the SORT OUT III trial, a randomized comparison of zotarolimus-eluting and sirolimus-eluting coronary stents with 18-month follow-up. 3:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Michael D. Ezekowitz. Discussion on a randomized clinical trial evaluating three doses of the oral direct Factor Xa inhibitor betrixaban in atrial fibrillation patients. 3:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Gary Michael Felker. Discussion on the DOSE study, a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial evaluating diuretic strategies in acute decompensated heart failure. 4:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. George H. Crossley III. Discussion on the impact of remote monitoring with automatic clinician notifications on the care of ICD and CRT-D patients. 4:30 PM: No interview scheduled. 5:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Henry Ginsberg. Discussion on the ACCORD Lipid Study, which examines the effects of combination lipid therapy on cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients. Monday, March 15, 2010: 8:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Rhonda M. Cooper-DeHoff. Discussion on findings from the INVEST study, which rethinks lower blood pressure goals for diabetics with documented coronary artery disease. 8:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Peter Clemmensen. Discussion on the DEDICATION trial, which evaluates long-term outcomes after drug-eluting versus bare-metal stent implantation in ST-elevation myocardial infarction patients, with three-year follow-up. 9:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Robert A. Byrne. Discussion on a randomized trial comparing polymer-free dual drug-eluting stents versus polymer-based Cypher and Endeavor drug-eluting stents, with two-year clinical and angiographic outcomes. 9:30 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Steven Goldman. Discussion on a randomized trial comparing radial artery grafts versus saphenous vein grafts in coronary artery bypass surgery, as part of the VA Cooperative Study. 10:00 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Ted Feldman. Discussion on the primary safety and efficacy endpoints of the EVEREST II randomized clinical trial. 10:20 AM: Interviewee: Dr. Claes Held. Discussion on the PLATO trial, which compares ticagrelor versus clopidogrel in acute coronary syndrome patients undergoing coronary artery bypass surgery. 11:00 AM: No interview scheduled. 11:30 AM: No interview scheduled. 12:00 PM: No interview scheduled. 12:30 PM: No interview scheduled. 1:00 PM: Interviewer: Dr. Bimal Shah. 1:30 PM: No interview scheduled. 2:15 PM: Interviewee: Dr. William C. Cushman. Discussion on the ACCORD Blood Pressure Trial, which evaluates the effects of intensive blood pressure control on cardiovascular events in type 2 diabetes mellitus patients. 2:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Robert S. Epstein. Discussion on the MM-WES study, which examines the effect of genotyping warfarin patients on clinical outcomes. 3:00 PM: No interview scheduled. 3:30 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Hisao Ogawa. 4:00 PM: Interviewee: Dr. Hisao Ogawa. Presentation on the Endo-PAT evaluation of endothelial function. 4:30 PM: No interview scheduled. Tuesday, March 16, 2010: 8:30 AM: No interview scheduled. 9:00 AM: Interviewer: Dr. Bimal R.
